needTwoTeams: At least 2 teams are required to generate a schedule.
matchDurationMin: Match duration must be at least 1 minute.
breakNegative: The break between matches cannot be negative.
lunchNegative: The lunch break duration cannot be negative.
needTwoQualifiersKnockout: At least 2 qualified teams are required to build a single-elimination bracket.
duplicateQualifiers: A team appears twice among the qualified teams.
needTwoQualifiersDoubleElim: At least 2 qualified teams are required for a double elimination.
needTwoTeamsPools: At least 2 teams are required to form groups.
swissRoundByRound: The Swiss system is generated round by round.
numPoolsRequired: The number of groups (format_config.numPools) is required (≥ 1).
qualifiersPerPoolMin: The number of qualifiers per group must be ≥ 1.
bestRunnersUpMin: The number of best runners-up must be an integer ≥ 0.
needTwoQualifiersFinal: At least 2 qualified teams are required for a knockout phase.
infeasibleConstraints: Cannot generate a schedule that meets the constraints with these settings. Increase the number of pitches or reduce the breaks.
internalBracketError: Internal bracket inconsistency: two byes paired (invalid entries).
thirdPlaceImpossible: Third-place match impossible with these qualified teams: two genuinely played semi-finals are required (at least 4 qualified teams, no bye in the semi-finals).
teamInTwoCategories: The same team (#{teamId}) appears in two categories: the categories of an event must have distinct teams.
qualifiersExceedPool: Cannot qualify {qualifiers} team(s): the smallest group only has {smallest}.
runnersUpImpossible: Runners-up impossible: only {available} group(s) reach position {position}, so {requested} cannot be picked.
